figures.label: Figure 2

caption.text: Figure 2: Overview of the AgentGym-RL framework. It features a decoupled, flexible, and extensible architecture, comprising three primary modules—the environment, the agent, and the training module. It supports diverse scenarios, environments, and algorithms. Given a task instruction u ∈ U, the agentic task requires the LLM agent to generate a sequence of actions aᵀₖ ∼ πθ (·|sₖ) based on its policy πθ parameterized by θ to complete the given task, where aₖ ∈ A, and sₖ ∈ S, and T is the reasoning path (Yao et al., 2023). The agent then receives an observation oₖ ∈ O from the environment, and the state is then transitioned to T(sₖ, aₖ) = sₖ₊₁. Finally after N turns of interactions, the environment e provides an outcome reward r(τ) ∈ [0, 1] to describe the completion of the multi-turn interactive decision-making tasks.

color.semantic_mapping: Blue blocks encode agent/trajectory state, yellow action or message cards, purple policy update, green scenario/environment categories, and gray scaffolding.

encodings.facet: three architecture bands plus environment ring
encodings.text: direct labels: LLM Agent, Env Client/Server, Update Policy, HTTP, Trajectory

figures.data_and_statistics: Conceptual architecture only: it names modules, scenarios and supported algorithms; the reward is shown symbolically as r(τ)=1 in the example. No empirical sample, denominator or uncertainty is encoded.
figures.evidence_relation: §3.1 的三模块架构与 environment–agent–training 接口在此形成方法总览；Figure 3 把它落到 API/并行流程，Figure 4–6、Tables 2/4 将接口映射到训练动态和算法结果。
design_strengths: 模块边界、HTTP 解耦、轨迹和 policy update 的方向关系一眼可见。
场景环形枚举与算法列表把框架的扩展面直接暴露给读者。
design_weaknesses: 目标横幅、图标、轨迹卡和环境环造成高信息密度，较小字号在两栏 PDF 中难读。
颜色承载多类语义但几乎没有形状/线型冗余；图示不表示并发、失败路径或资源成本。
figures.reusable_pattern: 用“主循环 + 模块块面 + 场景/算法枚举”组织可扩展框架，适合把接口边界放在结果图之前。

figures.reusable_pattern: 用多个并列 failure cases 做 aggregate claim 的边界证据，并把失败机制写进 trace。

caption.text: Figure 18: Instances of ’over-interaction’ failure on the WebArena task for both the base model and our RL agent.

color.semantic_mapping: Gray trace boxes and black text carry evidence; red 0.0 scores mark failure.

figures.data_and_statistics: Two WebArena cases show base and RL agents reaching relevant pages but wasting actions; both visible scores are 0.0. The caption calls this over-interaction failure but does not define prevalence, task selection or whether columns are paired conditions.
figures.evidence_relation: Qualifies Table 5 and Figures 15–16: reaching the right site is separable from efficient extraction/completion. It is the appendix counterpart to Figure 8’s resource concern.
design_strengths: Concrete traces reveal redundant clicking, hovering and scrolling as a distinct failure mode.
Two examples show the issue is not confined to one task.
design_weaknesses: Both panels are headed only “WebArena”, so base/RL identity is not visually explicit in the page-level image.
Caption and trace lack a quantitative frequency or action-cost summary; the selected examples cannot estimate rate.
figures.reusable_pattern: 把“到达正确状态但没有有效完成”拆成可观察的 over-interaction failure pattern。

cross_object_system.visual_narrative: The visual narrative moves from Figure 1’s five-scenario/model-scale headline to Figures 2–3’s architecture/API, Figures 4–6’s train-time mechanism and coverage, Table 1 plus Figures 7–8’s result/scaling/efficiency evidence, then Appendix Figures 9–22 and Tables 5–8 for curriculum intuition, reproducibility UI, task slices and qualitative successes/failures.
cross_object_system.caption_system: Captions are numbered and usually sentence-case descriptive. Main charts often use title-only or setup captions; Table 1 and appendix benchmark tables define best/second-best and abbreviations. Figure 4 and selected qualitative figures state findings, but Figures 5–8, 19–22 leave the principal interpretation to surrounding prose; Figure 14 has a material caption–image task mismatch and Figure 15 contains a punctuation typo.
cross_object_system.table_header_system: Benchmark tables use a Model column, task/subtask columns and Overall, with gray italic group bands and bold/underline best-vs-second-best. T1/T5–T8 use percentage values and two-decimal appendix precision (T1 native PDF is mostly one decimal); T2–T4 use compact task/ablation headers. Grouping is visually consistent but task-count/aggregation definitions remain in body text.
cross_object_system.method_result_ablation_link: Figures 2–3 establish modular rollout/update interfaces; Figure 4 and Table 3 test ScalingInter-RL’s progressive horizon; Figure 5/7 test inference-time turns/samples; Figure 8 measures resource consequences; Tables 2 and 4 test algorithm portability. The link is coherent, although uncertainty and denominator details are largely absent.
cross_object_system.main_appendix_link: Table 1 and Figure 1 provide the headline while Tables 5–8 provide WebArena/TextCraft/BabyAI/SciWorld slices; Figures 9 and 11 diagnose the method mechanism; Figures 12–22 expose selected successes and failure boundaries. Appendix H is especially useful for explaining why aggregate TextCraft gains do not imply universal long-horizon reliability.
cross_object_system.typography_consistency: Native tables consistently use Nimbus Roman/Monospace PDF objects and bold/italic group labels. Charts use small DejaVu/Arial-like labels, while conceptual/qualitative objects use Times/Consolas-like text. The regimes are internally coherent but chart legends, UI screenshots and trace text often fall below comfortable two-column reading size.
cross_object_system.color_consistency: Orange/red/green/blue/purple method and outcome accents recur across plots and traces, and gray group bands recur across tables. Color is often reinforced by labels, hatches, markers or column placement, but many chart comparisons still rely primarily on color and are not reliably grayscale-safe.

most_reusable_patterns: Headline-to-decomposition pairing: a compact cross-scenario chart followed by task-level benchmark tables with Overall and consistent model groups.
Mechanism panel pairing: performance curve next to interaction/resource or gradient diagnostic, plus a separate progressive-curriculum schematic.
Selected qualitative cases use aligned Baseline versus ScalingInter-RL trace columns, explicit task goals and terminal scores, then trajectory montages for path/action/feedback.
Consistent bold/underline best-versus-second-best and gray row-group bands make wide benchmark tables scannable without vertical rules.
failure_patterns: Dense small legends, long model names and color-heavy charts reduce paper-scale and grayscale readability.
Most plots and all benchmark tables omit replicate counts and uncertainty definitions; Figure 6 shows a band without saying what it represents.
Selected qualitative traces lack sampling/selection metadata and cannot quantify prevalence; captions 5–8 and 19–22 are too terse for standalone interpretation.
Figure 14 caption describes a banana/purple-box task while the rendered task is sodium-chloride conductivity; Figure 15 has “1.0., while” punctuation.
Zero values in Table 8 are not explicitly labeled as failure versus missingness, although surrounding text explains the all-zero Chem-Mix limitation.
final_judgment.one_sentence_visual_strategy: Use a compact multi-environment headline, modular architecture and progressive-horizon mechanism panels to motivate ScalingInter-RL, then connect benchmark tables, resource/scaling diagnostics and appendix trace cases so aggregate gains and their failure boundaries are visible in one consistent but deliberately mixed visual system.
